title: Amazon sees 35-40 pc festive demand spike, adds 50 pc capacity with Rs 2,800 crore investment
summary: Amazon India is observing a notable increase in customer demand as the festive season approaches. The company has enhanced its capacity significantly by adding numerous fulfillment and delivery centers. They plan to create over 160,000 temporary jobs to accommodate this increase in demand. Additionally, Amazon aims to expand its quick-commerce offering, Amazon Now, to 300 cities by 2026.
